name: Praetor Imperial
description: Praetor impérial orchestrant les opérations de domination galactique sur plusieurs fronts avec une coordination parfaite.

subject.archetype: Praetor Imperial — Hégémonie martienne Epic class obsidienne

loadout.armor_outfit: Heavy combat armor with thick crimson red plating showing battle scars and scorch marks, reinforced shoulder guards with dented imperial insignia, tactical undersuit at joints, magnetic combat boots locked to metal deck forged from rare materials with faction crest embedded and energy pulsing through the entire surface with every movement
loadout.arsenal: Standard-issue heavy plasma rifle with imperial engravings, combat chainsword with serrated edge, tactical grenade bandolier across chest, targeting visor HUD displaying red lock-on data Functional combat equipment showing signs of heavy practical use and field customization

attitude.behavior: Strategic orchestrator coordinating multi-unit movements with sweeping gestures at center of chaos. Combat stance with weapon or tool raised and ready, eyes locked on approaching threat, body coiled like a spring ready to explode into action
attitude.emotion: Apocalyptic fury — full weight of faction's power channeling through body uncontrollably

style.rendering_style: cinematic action photography with gritty realism, motion blur on projectiles and debris, sharp focus on character face and primary weapon, high contrast lighting with dramatic deep shadows

palette_names.name: Crimson Red
palette_names.role: primary_accent — armor plating and blood mist in the air

palette_names.name: Gunmetal Black
palette_names.role: secondary_accent — structural elements and deepest shadows

palette_names.name: Blinding White
palette_names.role: tertiary accent — muzzle flash and explosive ignition

color_and_light.lighting_setup: amethyst alloy frame with crystalline energy channels pulsing light along border edges, explosive backlight from ability discharge, dramatic rim lighting separating character from environmental chaos, volumetric light rays cutting through smoke and particles

camera.angle: Wide dramatic low angle showing full blast radius, character backlit by their own power source, foreground devastated by ability effects

scenography.setting: Planetary assault battlefield with artillery detonating sending massive dust columns skyward, advancing infantry silhouettes through smoke, orbital dropships descending under anti-aircraft fire, trenches littered with spent casings
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Tension and lethal potential visible in every tensed muscle — combat readiness radiating from posture and grip on weapon, Active combat zone with explosions and engagements around the character, allies and enemies locked in fierce battle, chaos of war as backdrop, Artillery shells exploding in background sending up massive geysers of red dust, tracer rounds streaking across sky, crimson smoke grenades billowing, shrapnel flying past camera, ground cracking from impact tremors
